comment: region.c rest_regions() subtracts the turns spent away from each timed region of a returning level and removes any whose time has run out, without running its expire callback. A debug-mode Archeologist wishes for a cursed scroll of stinking cloud, reads it, and centres the five-square cloud five columns to his left, where its time to live is four to six turns. He level-teleports to depth 3 at once, forces twelve searches with the m prefix so that monsters can neither refuse nor interrupt them, and returns to depth 1, where C has discarded the cloud. The seed, clock and character were chosen for this case.
